hook.text_top: She freezes as the faceless crowd erupts.
hook.voice: She freezes as the faceless crowd erupts.

intro_voice: Here's the original, made with Seedance 2.5.

shots.label: The look
shots.excerpt: Close-up at eye level, looking straight into the lens. She slowly exhales a soft cloud of white smoke, lowers her eyes and turns her back to the camera.
highlight: exhales a soft cloud of white smoke
turns her back to the camera
shots.voice: It opens on a close-up. She exhales, looks down and turns away from us.

shots.label: The crowd
shots.excerpt: About 300 men, each head completely wrapped in smooth cream-white fabric like a featureless cloth hood. She squeezes between two rows of masked men; the camera keeps pulling back.
shots.voice: The crowd is the secret. Featureless cloth hoods turn 300 extras into one eerie wall.

shots.label: The stillness
shots.excerpt: Wide frontal shot from slightly above: she stands completely still, staring into the lens; the entire crowd is frozen. Her bare face and black sweater the only contrast.
highlight: Wide frontal shot from slightly above
shots.voice: Five seconds of total stillness. The black sweater is the only dark thing in the frame, so your eye locks on her.

shots.label: The trigger
shots.excerpt: On a steady beat every man clutches his stomach and snaps forward at the waist, then snaps back upright with heads cocked to one side. She stays perfectly still.
shots.voice: Then the beat drops. Everyone folds in sync, while she does not move at all.

shots.label: The camera
shots.excerpt: One continuous take. The camera continues a smooth pull-back and rise to extreme wide, revealing the full half-dome brick arch and the empty plaza.
shots.voice: And it's all one take. The camera keeps rising until the giant brick arch is revealed.
